title: XOS1 check-in
description: What an XOS1 install sends to POST /api/v1/checkin. The request body is {payload, signature, public_key}: payload is base64 of the UTF-8 JSON below, signature is base64 of the Ed25519 signature over exactly those payload bytes, public_key is base64 of the install's 32-byte Ed25519 public key. The private key never leaves the PC (seal it with Windows DPAPI).

hardware_hash.description: sha256 of core/system/device_identity.py's hardware_id. The raw id never leaves the PC.

sent_at.description: UTC. Refused if more than 10 minutes from server time.

nonce.description: Random per check-in. Refused if reused within a day.

profile.description: User agreed at setup to share name and age. False clears what the server held.
Sent only when consent.profile is true; ignored otherwise.

usage.description: Sent only when consent.usage is true; ignored otherwise.
